title: ochna parviflora
intro: Ochna parviflora, commonly known as Mickey Mouse plant or Small-Flowered Ochna, is a plant species in the family Ochnaceae. It is traditionally used in South African folk medicine and has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Ochna parviflora are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, that have been shown to possess antioxidant, anti-cancer, and anti-diabetic activities. The plant's bioactive constituents are also responsible for its potential therapeutic uses, such as treating infections, wounds, and digestive issues.
